title: Scaling Kubernetes to 7,500 nodes
snippet: We’ve scaled Kubernetes clusters to 7,500 nodes, producing a scalable infrastructure for large models like GPT-3, CLIP, and DALL·E, but also for rapid small-scale iterative research such as Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models.

title: CLIP: Connecting text and images

title: DALL·E: Creating images from text
snippet: We’ve trained a neural network called DALL·E that creates images from text captions for a wide range of concepts expressible in natural language.
